test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same die are shown in the figure, six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number which will be on the face opposite to the face with the number '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/569a1baa7d3baa2825fc5b28f0242f01ad0f1b468cf01dace286ad422292b0dc.png]
solution:
In the first and second dice 3 and 5 are common in both dice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9add3de983e3ac9a655f853c1b986c84c9ced03f6196cf2b190a0cb13b02cb8f.png] 

Clearly, here 2 is opposite of 6

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**
